title: Ridge model refinements after Gen288: robust (Huber) regression; raw + vol-scaled ensemble (vs v8.2)
A_huber: v8.2 ridge unchanged (features incl. kimchi breadth, vol-scaled target, monthly walk-forward, standardised features) but fitted with sklearn HuberRegressor(epsilon=1.35, alpha=10 / n_train, max_iter=500) instead of Ridge(alpha=10)
B_ensemble: prediction = mean of the v8.1 ridge (raw target) and the v8.2 ridge (vol-scaled target) scaled / clipped predictions; position 0.5 x mean
pass: each replaces the ridge sleeve: sleeve D 2021-22 > 0, TEST >= 0.8, HOLD >= 0.5 and strict rule vs v8.2 (2.636 / 1.203 / 3.764 / 2.357)
